name: MonarchTimezoneSelect
title: TimezoneSelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox (a field Button that presents a sheet with a searchable List) over TimeZone.knownTimeZoneIdentifiers, with TimeZone.secondsFromGMT(for:) and localizedName(for:locale:)
summary: A searchable IANA time zone picker, labelled by UTC offset and city and sorted by offset, with Detected, Pinned and Recent sections.
whenToUse: Wherever a person chooses a time zone: profile settings, a meeting's zone, a workspace's office hours.
whenNotToUse: Not for showing the time in several zones, which is a world clock or MonarchEventChip text. Not for choosing a city or address, which is a place search.
api: init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<String?>, prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, zones: [String]? = nil, detectedZone: String? = nil, showsDetected: Bool = true, pinned: [String] = [], recent: [String] = [], now: Date? = nil, isRequired: Bool = false, isClearable: Bool = true, isReadOnly: Bool = false, labels: MonarchTimezoneSelectLabels = MonarchTimezoneSelectLabels(), formatLabel: (@Sendable (MonarchTimezoneInfo) -> String)? = nil)
MonarchTimezoneInfo.init(id: String, city: String, region: String, offsetSeconds: Int, offsetLabel: String, longName: String)

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label; it names the field and the sheet.

options.name: selection
options.description: The IANA id of the chosen zone. An old id such as Asia/Calcutta selects its current name.

options.name: prompt
options.description: Shown in the field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, shown with an icon and announced.

options.name: zones
options.description: Limits the list to these zones. Every zone the system knows when nil.

options.name: detectedZone
options.description: The zone under Detected. The environment's time zone when nil.

options.name: showsDetected
options.description: Whether the Detected section is shown.

options.name: pinned
options.description: Zones listed under Pinned, such as the workspace's offices.

options.name: recent
options.description: Zones listed under Recent, such as the person's last choices.

options.name: now
options.description: The instant offsets and long names are computed for, daylight saving included. The current time when nil.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds Required to the hint.

options.name: isClearable
options.description: Shows a clear button in the field while a zone is chosen.

options.name: isReadOnly
options.description: Shows the chosen zone as selectable text in the field box, with Read only in the hint. It does not open the list and has no clear button.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the section headings, the empty text and the combobox's own strings.

options.name: formatLabel
options.description: Builds an option's label from the zone's information. Built in: "(UTC+05:30) Kolkata".

states.name: closed
states.description: The field shows the chosen zone's label, or the prompt.

states.name: open
states.description: A sheet with a search field and the Detected, Pinned and Recent sections, then every zone by offset under All time zones.

states.name: searching
states.description: Only the full list is searched, so a zone appears once; every word typed must match.

appearance: The MonarchCombobox field and sheet: the field uses the text-field roles, the list is the system list with the chosen zone marked by a check mark. All colours come from the theme.
platformNotes: The web is an inline combobox with a popup list; on iOS MonarchCombobox opens a sheet with a searchable List, which suits touch and VoiceOver. The web computes offsets with Intl; iOS uses TimeZone, which knows the same IANA zones. The system list includes old ids such as Asia/Calcutta, so ids are mapped to their current names as the web does. The detected zone comes from the environment's time zone, not from the browser. Long names follow the environment's locale instead of a locale prop.
accessibility: The field is a button labelled with label; its value is the chosen zone's label or None.
In the sheet, each zone is a button read with its label and its id and long name; the chosen one has the selected trait and a check mark.
Section headings name Detected, Pinned, Recent and All time zones.
Errors are shown with an icon and announced, as in MonarchCombobox.
Rows and the field are at least 44 points high.
edgeCases: A selected zone missing from zones is still listed and shown.
A zone the system does not know shows an offset of UTC+00:00 and no long name.
Long names that are only an offset, such as GMT+05:30, are left out.
Building every option reads about 440 zones; pass zones to limit the list in tight screens.

examples.title: Detected and pinned zones
examples.template:
MonarchTimezoneSelect(
    {{label}},
    selection: $zone,
    prompt: {{placeholder}},
    helper: {{description}},
    detectedZone: {{detectedZone}},
    pinned: [{{pinned.0}}, {{pinned.1}}],
    now: {{now|date}},
    isClearable: false
)
examples.code:
MonarchTimezoneSelect(
    "Workspace time zone",
    selection: $zone,
    prompt: "Search city, country or offset",
    helper: "Reports and reminders use this zone.",
    detectedZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
    pinned: ["Europe/London", "America/New_York"],
    now: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_768_478_400),
    isClearable: false
)

examples.title: A curated list
examples.code:
MonarchTimezoneSelect(
    "Meeting time zone",
    selection: $zone,
    prompt: "Choose a time zone",
    zones: ["UTC", "Europe/Paris", "Asia/Kolkata", "America/Los_Angeles"],
    showsDetected: false,
    isRequired: true
)
